items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
items.description:
Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value.

This update builds on the existing Agent 365 Dashboard adoption experience by connecting agent activity with a clearer view of the work agents support across the organization.

items.title: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
items.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App (iOS)
items.description: Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (iOS) now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Dataverse data connected to Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.description: Let people search and query Dataverse business data from Microsoft 365 Copilot.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
items.description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning issues, or compliance risk, simplifying high-volume, structured document workflows across the organization.

items.title: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
items.description: Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call delegation
items.description: Incoming Teams calls don't wait for a break in your day. Intelligent call delegation provides AI-powered calling assistance so you can focus on the conversations that matter most. It answers calls and gathers context, helping you decide whether to pick up and engage the caller. It can also schedule follow-up appointments through an integration with Microsoft Bookings so you can reconnect with callers at a more convenient time.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Branded footer in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app
items.description: This update introduces a co-branding experience in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app that helps organizations present an admin approved visual identifier directly within the Chat screen. Specifically, the experience enables administrators to leverage the organization-supported logo already managed in the Microsoft Admin Center theming settings and display it in the footer of the Chat screen, paired with a fixed label: “Approved by”.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents
items.description: Users in GCC-H will be able to use custom engine agents.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent Dashboard.
items.description: Viva Insights is creating an Agent Dashboard, designed to be a central place for leaders, delegates and analysts to understand how your organization is adopting agents. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Cloud Attachments preservation for users on hold
items.description: Enables cloud attachment preservation for users put on infinite hold so that file versions shared are preserved across any OneDrive or SharePoint site. This is a new capability which is different from the existing capability of applying label to cloud attachments and links present in OneDrive and SharePoint and shared in Exchange, Teams, Viva Engage and Copilot

items.title: Outlook: Draft, edit and format emails conversationally with Copilot in Outlook
items.description: In Outlook, Copilot now works side by side with users to draft, refine, and format emails conversationally, powered by the same agentic capabilities available in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Chat: Access to UBB models via the model selector
items.description: Users will be able to access models that require usage-based billing (UBB) from the model selector in Chat. Tenant admins will need to allocate credits so that users can interact with these models. If users consume their allotted credits, they will be able to request credits from their tenant admins.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Dataverse Business Skills in Sales Agent
items.description:
Business Skills are natural language instructions authored and stored in Microsoft Dataverse that teach Sales Agent how work gets done within a specific organization. Business Skills enable organizations to create natural language instructions for Sales Agent to follow, which represent their business processes, policies, and business knowledge. Business skills can represent common sales workflows such as lead qualification, pipeline reviews, account planning, opportunity scoring, account brief creation, or organization-specific sales methodologies. Sales Agent uses the instructions in Business Skills to deliver responses that align with the customer's business processes and guidance.

Sellers can interact with Sales agent using natural language and receive responses that are guided by their organization's Business Skills, following admin defined sales processes, applying company specific guidance, and surface insights that reflect how the organization operations.

Administrators enable the required Dataverse capabilities, create and manage Business skills within Dataverse, and control Business skill access. Business skills can be authored using natural language instructions and associated with the organization's CRM environment.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Commercial Journeys - AI-powered task completion for Microsoft 365 Copilot users
items.description: Commercial Journeys helps information workers stay on top of their most important work when browsing in Microsoft Edge. Powered by AI, it proactively surfaces unfinished, new, and recurring tasks on the Copilot new tab page- with context-rich cards that explain why each task matters now. One click opens a guided execution flow that delivers ready-to-use outputs (emails, documents, presentations, and more), so users can complete their unfinished work faster with higher quality. This feature will be available to users with a Microsoft 365 Copilot Premium license in Edge.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio
items.description: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents. A single "Review" indicator in the build experience surfaces anything blocking or at risk — from policy restrictions to missing evaluations — before it derails a publish. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front with a clear reason, so makers never waste time configuring something that was never going to work.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
items.description:
Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

This feature will work for new/updated user's working files on a go-forward basis.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Adaptive card-based app & copilot agent link unfurling in Teams
items.description: Discover and add SharePoint agents in chats and channels from in-context store. Users can click on 'Add agents and bots' from the roster drop down. This will open the in-context store, where users can discover SharePoint agents and add them directly to the conversation and collaborate in the group. Updated January 29, 2026: Due to a blocker we have paused rollout until March for this feature. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Improve purchase order matching in Payables Agent
items.description:
This feature improves PO matching quality in Payables Agent and aligns draft finalization behavior with existing posting controls.

The agent uses an enriched PO Lines list page during matching that includes these fields:

  • Line Amount — enables matching on value, not just description and quantity. This field is especially valuable for service lines where quantity (often just 1) isn't a meaningful discriminator.
  • Expected Receipt Date — helps the agent factor in timing when multiple PO lines could match.

By using these fields, the agent can more reliably distinguish between similar-looking PO lines, which improves accuracy in first-pass matches.

The agent now respects the app's Never block draft finalization setting in the Receipt on Invoice field on purchase orders. This change means the agent doesn't block draft finalization because a matched PO line isn't yet marked as received. Whether goods are received is a posting time control, not a draft time control. The "Receipt on Invoice" setting on the order governs this behavior at posting.

The "Receipt on Invoice" field is already available on purchase orders. With this release, we're expanding this setting to more entities:

  • A new vendor-level "Receipt on Invoice" setting is introduced and automatically applied to new purchase orders created for a vendor.
  • A new PO-line-level "Receipt on Invoice" setting allows per-line override. The inheritance chain for the setting is vendor, then purchase order, and then purchase order line, but each level can override the parent.

We've also improved draft warnings. When the agent creates a purchase invoice draft matched to a PO, the draft surfaces warnings based not just on quantity, but also on amount. The draft warnings are for information only and don't block finalization. For example, they warn about the discrepancies in the draft and you can decide how to proceed.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Sales tools, skills and plugin are now available in Copilot Cowork
items.description:
The updated Sales plugin brings expanded Dynamics 365 Sales context, actions, and guided workflows to Copilot Cowork, building on the native Sales skills already available in Cowork. Sellers can work with sales data and take supported actions directly in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365 Sales.

The native Sales skills invoke tools published through the Dynamics 365 MCP server to retrieve sales context and perform supported actions in Dynamics 365 Sales. These native Sales skills are included in the Sales plugin, which will be delivered through the updated MOS package for the Sales app, providing administrators with a governed way to deploy and manage the capabilities.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Updates to Agent UI experience
items.description: Manage agents more easily by grouping avatars and using a dedicated action to start new tasks.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Manage agent permissions easier
items.description: Assign additional permissions to agents when they request them.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Review content generated by agents directly on pages
items.description:
This improvement introduces the ability for Business Central users to review and approve content generated by agents directly on the pages where they work. You no longer need to navigate to separate task pane to understand that a given document was created by an agent. Instead, agent-generated suggestions—such as descriptions, text proposals, or field-specific updates—appear inline where they can be evaluated and modified before being applied.

By keeping the review process within the page context, users maintain flow, reduce clicks, and ensure content quality with minimal disruption. The feature builds on existing Business Central autofill user interface patterns ensuring admins and users can adopt it as part of existing agent-powered daily workflows.

Business Value:
The ability to review agent-generated content directly on pages helps organizations streamline their daily work while maintaining accuracy and control. You can evaluate suggestions in the context of the task you are performing, reducing interruptions and improving the quality of the final output.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Show avatars for record creators and modifiers in list
items.description:
This feature introduces visual avatars in Business Central list pages to indicate which user or agent created or last modified a record. The capability enhances traceability and supports collaborative work by making identity information immediately visible without opening the record.

The avatars reflect either a named Business Central user, a system user or an AI agent, following the existing identity model. Users can hover over the avatar to see a tooltip with the full display name and record update timestamp (if available).

This improvement benefits roles that frequently work with shared data—including accountants, order processors, warehouse staff, service teams, and administrators—by reducing time spent verifying ownership or responsibility for items, documents, or configuration entries. It also helps organizations adopting AI-generated records understand when an automated agent has contributed.

The feature surfaces existing Created By and Modified By fields more intuitively while respecting Business Central’s data privacy and permissions model.

Business Value:
Supporting avatars for the users or agents who created and last modified entries makes record ownership clearer and easier to understand across Business Central. By surfacing identity information directly in list pages, you can quickly determine responsibility, follow up with the right person, and work with shared data more confidently.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Manage tasks from all agents in dedicated task pane
items.description:
This feature introduces a dedicated task pane in Business Central that displays all tasks generated by the agents.

The task pane appears as an additional panel in the user interface and can be opened from anywhere in Business Central. Tasks include suggestions, validations, follow-ups access to draft documents, and other agent-initiated actions. Users can review task details, navigate directly to the affected record, complete tasks, or dismiss them.

This improvement primarily benefits roles that rely heavily on AI-driven workflows—such as accountants, sales people, and managers—who often engage with multiple agents throughout the day. The task pane reduces friction by collecting all insights in a single location, minimizing missed tasks and improving throughput.

Business Value:
The Show all agent tasks on a separate task pane feature help organizations get more value from Microsoft Copilot in Business Central by giving users a single, structured place to review and act on AI-generated tasks. Instead of relying on notifications scattered across different pages, users gain a clear, consolidated overview of all tasks created by agents working in finance, purchasing, sales, and operations.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Enable Microsoft Copilot chat experience
items.description:
The updated Microsoft Copilot chat experience introduces a modern, consistent, and intuitive interface that aligns Business Central with the broader Microsoft Copilot ecosystem. The enhancement modernizes the chat panel, streamlines navigation, and improves user workflows by adopting familiar interaction patterns from Microsoft Copilot.

This update benefits users who regularly interact with Copilot to accelerate daily tasks - especially operations managers, accountants, sales representatives, and administrators who rely on conversational assistance to navigate and analyse data. It also provides a more predictable experience across Microsoft 365 applications, reducing onboarding time and helping organizations adopt AI capabilities more systematically.

Business Value:
The updated Copilot chat experience provides a familiar and consistent AI experience across Business Central and Microsoft applications. You get started faster, switch more easily between applications, and interact with AI more confidently, helping improve productivity and accelerate adoption.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Run data queries with MCP Server
items.description: Use new MCP tools to define, validate, and run custom data queries. Your MCP application can then query data for which no existing APIs exist.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Service tools, skills and plugins are now available for Cowork, Code and Scout
items.description:
The updated Service application brings Dynamics 365 Customer Service context, actions, and guided workflows into supported Copilot experiences, including Chat, Cowork, Code, and Scout. Customer service teams can work with service information and take supported actions in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365.

First-party tools delivered through the Service package on Dynamics 365 MCP respect Dynamics 365 business logic and the user's existing permissions on each call. The package provides a governed foundation for the supported tools and skills. Availability is tracked separately for each experience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Self-learning for Copilot Studio Agents
items.description: Soon agents can help makers improve agents using lessons from completed runs. It will identify repeated tool sequences that can be handled by workflows to standardize agent behavior, minimize errors, and most importantly control costs. Makers will be presented with recommendations and supporting evidence, expected impact, and the related instruction and tool changes. Makers accept recommendations, configure, test, and publish a refined copy of the agent. This helps improve agent output quality and controls costs while preserving work that requires model judgment and keeping makers in control.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Persistent identity for Copilot Studio Agents
items.description: Makers can now give their Copilot Studio agents their own accounts, making it a governed Microsoft 365 identity for shared, collaborative business processes that spans across teams. With its own mailbox, Teams presence & Office access, the agent can collaborate where work happens while admins can control and govern its access, policies and use as its own first-class entity.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Use Copilot Chat after a call in Queues app
items.description: After a recorded call is completed, use Copilot in the Queues app to quickly catch up on key details, uncover insights, and resolve customer issues faster without having to manually search through a transcript or listen back to a recording. Navigate to the unified call history in the Queues app, select the recorded call record, and launch the Copilot Chat sidecar from within the Recap tab. You can then ask Copilot to generate a summary or answer questions about specific details related to the call.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM – New Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management Experience
items.description: At Ignite, Microsoft is introducing a major evolution of Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) to help organizations strengthen data security and confidently embrace AI. The new DSPM experience unifies visibility and control across traditional data and AI-driven environments, delivering outcome-based guided workflows that turn insights into actionable steps—so teams can prioritize risks and remediate faster. It brings AI observability, enhanced posture reporting, and intelligent Security Copilot agents to automate tasks like triage and policy management. Plus, Purview now extends coverage beyond Microsoft data with third-party signals from partners like BigID, Cyera, OneTrust, and Varonis, giving security teams a single, streamlined view of sensitive data across clouds and platforms. Together, these innovations make DSPM the central hub for managing data security posture in the era of AI. We are also extending Data Risk Assessments to Fabric and to item-level analysis with new remediation actions like bulk disabling of overshared SharePoint links.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Deep citations in Copilot
items.description: Deep citations let users quickly verify Copilot's results by linking directly to the relevant part of the reference, boosting trust. We're starting with Word and PPT files, then adding Meetings, Web, and PDF references.

items.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Iphone)
items.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively. We inadvertently marked this item as rolling out and now have updated it to be accurate. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
items.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. With the Question and Answer at your fingertips, you can get real-time answers to your queries directly within your notes, enhancing your ability to access and utilize information quickly and effectively.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Discover & Add Skills from the skill catalog
items.description: With the Skills catalog in Copilot Studio, makers can discover, reuse and selectively share approved organizational skills instead of recreating the same instructions and workflows for every agent. The shared catalog powered by Microsoft 365 App Store enables shared skills to extend across experiences such as Copilot Studio M365 copilot, and Cowork, helping organizations standardize proven ways of working while maintaining centralized governance.

items.title: Work IQ: ExpandedContextIQ
items.description: Expand Context IQ so users can discover and select additional agents, skills, and content sources while composing prompts.

items.title: Work IQ: Custom agents + 3P calls
items.description: Enable Work IQ to invoke custom agents and agents that call supported third-party tools.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Delegated prompt publishing for organization prompts
items.description: This release follows the availability of organization prompts, providing admins the ability to upload custom prompts for their organization in the Copilot app home screen. Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab, without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Admins can continue to monitor and provide oversight through the current experience in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Microsoft 365 admin center - Usage reports - Copilot Chat for GCC, GCC High and DoD
items.description: We will be introducing a new Usage report covering Copilot Chat. This report will include total active users, Copilot Chat usage with a breakout per Microsoft 365 app, and user-level activity insights (anonymized by default). #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
items.description:
Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed.
#copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Excel Agent
items.description: Excel Agent helps you turn data into clear charts, summaries, and insights using built-in formulas and logic. It streamlines data preparation, formulas, and visualization so you can stay focused on the story behind the numbers. Use multi-turn chat to refine your output or open it in Excel for full editing and collaboration. Ideal for financial forecasts, project plans, and decision-making tools. Available to Microsoft 365 users with or without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Live subtitles on voice chat in Copilot when using the quick composer
items.description: Live subtitles for voice chats in Copilot will be available for users to help them follow the conversation when using the quick composer.

items.title: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
items.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
items.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

items.title: OneDrive: Prompt gallery for Copilot
items.description:
Discover easier ways to use Copilot in OneDrive
The new Prompt Gallery offers ready-to-use prompts for common file tasks, helping you get started quickly, discover what Copilot can do, and customize prompts to fit your needs.

Access the Prompt Gallery from:

The Copilot button in the bottom-right corner of OneDrive
The + button in the Copilot chat pane
Select Open Prompt Gallery to explore prompts across categories such as Create, Analyze, Find, and Collaborate.

items.title: Microsoft Clipchamp: Copilot video creation updates
items.description: Copilot brings agentic video creation to Clipchamp Video Hub. Users can generate, edit, and refine videos from prompts—grounded in explicit documents or implicit WorkIQ knowledge. Preview and playback video directly in chat, then continue iterating towards a finished video.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files
items.description: Copilot Chat can now better match search results from text that appears inside images embedded in Word and PowerPoint files is user's working files — such as scanned contracts in Word, text from tables, text from images — content that was previously difficult to search and find.

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
items.description: Multimodal capture enables users to transcribe audio, take images, and type notes in a single session. Copilot then creates a structured Copilot Page with insights and user-captured content, saved to a user-selected Copilot Notebook. Designed for capturing offline work moments—including in-person conversations, whiteboard sessions, and personal notes. This capability is already generally available on OneNote for iPhone and iPad.

items.title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Maker Guidelines
items.description:
The Maker guidelines feature gives organizations a direct way to share guidance with Copilot Studio makers in the flow of work. Administrators can explain which tools, models, connectors, and channels are approved for an environment and point makers to the right policy, request process, or support contact.

The message appears in the Review pane alongside the agent's blockers and warnings and remains available when the agent has no issues. This gives makers a consistent place to understand organizational expectations and find help without leaving Copilot Studio.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for Copilot in PowerPoint
items.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
items.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in SharePoint
items.description: Simplifies SharePoint content management and ensures content is Copilot-ready by automating metadata, fixing stale content, enabling fast page creation, improving compliance, and enriching content so Copilot can deliver more accurate, grounded answers. Updated April 16: We are still in development for GA and have launched to Preview only.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ground Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge for Business in your open OneDrive and SharePoint documents
items.description: Get relevant answers and insights about your open cloud documents in Copilot Chat in Edge.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Microsoft Copilot in Field Service Mobile app
items.description: Microsoft Copilot in the Dynamics 365 Field Service mobile app brings conversational AI chat capabilities directly to frontline workers. Once enabled, technicians can ask natural-language questions about Dynamics 365 Field Service data and receive contextual answers based on the app experience and their organization’s Dataverse data. With standard capabilities, Dataverse Q&A supports questions such as “What is the work history of this asset?” or “Who worked on this job last?” Organizations can also extend the with custom experiences and agents available to frontline and back-office users.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
items.description:
We’re introducing the new readiness for Microsoft Copilot and data explorer experiences in Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). These new capabilities provide data security teams with greater visibility into their organization’s data security posture and help them assess risks, investigate findings, and prioritize remediation.

The readiness for Microsoft Copilot experience in Purview DSPM helps organizations assess and improve their data readiness for Microsoft Copilot. It brings together insights into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage, helping security teams identify risks and assess progress toward a more secure Microsoft Copilot deployment.

The new data explorer experience in Purview DSPM provides a centralized investigation experience that helps organizations understand where sensitive data exists across sites, review site-level access, and explore relevant data through preset views. It brings together sites, sensitive data, and preset views, to support more efficient investigations and reduce context switching.

items.title: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Windows)
items.description: Capture on Windows helps you bring conversations and ideas from meetings, brainstorming sessions, and everyday work into Copilot Notebooks. Capture audio, images, and notes in one experience, then let Copilot turn them into structured notes with key insights, decisions, and action items, in a Copilot Notebook of your choice
